status_effects.explanation: Being paired with the duchess as a model of authentic old French speech modestly elevates Françoise's local standing as a linguistic authority.
Being cited as an example of incorrect pronunciation mildly diminishes her in the passage's local hierarchy of linguistic taste.

appraisal_events.evidence: on retrouve le vieux langage et la vraie prononciation des mots... en causant avec une Mme de Guermantes ou une Françoise ; j'avais appris de la deuxième, dès l'âge de cinq ans, qu'on ne dit pas le Tarn, mais le Tar
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator places Françoise on the same plane as the aristocratic duchess as an authority on pure, authentic French speech, a distinct local elevation of her own linguistic prestige.

appraisal_events.evidence: je n'eus pas à y apprendre qu'il ne fallait pas dire, comme faisait Mme Bontemps : Madame de Béarn
appraisal_events.explanation: Mme Bontemps is singled out as making a linguistic error (mispronouncing the name), positioned as lacking the authentic pure French that Françoise and the duchess embody.
